🧰 Go Tool Manager (Version: v9.9.9)

Usage: gotools <command> [options]
       <go install command> | gotools     (pipe mode)

Commands:
  init                                     Bootstrap the project and adopt tools already declared in the root go.mod.
  install [name] <pkg>                     Install a new tool.
  sync                                     Sync tool state to match .gotools.json.
  migrate <unified|split|module>           Migrate to a different strategy.
  version                                  Show the gotools version.
  info <tool-name>                         Show detailed information about a specific tool.
  check                                    Verify all managed tools are runnable.
  config [key [value]]                     View or edit .gotools.json configuration.
  remove <name...>                         Remove specific tools.
  rename <old> <new>                       Rename a tool (manifest + modfiles).
  upgrade <name|all>                       Upgrade tools to @latest.
  list                                     List tools, versions, and strategies.
  exec <name> [args]                       Run a managed tool.
  uninstall                                Remove gotools from your system.
  purge                                    Remove all tools and the .gotools.json file.
  doctor                                   Diagnose your environment.
  self-update                              Update gotools to the latest version.
  completion <bash|zsh|fish|pwsh|install>  Print or install shell completions.

Strategies:
  unified  One shared tools/go.mod with all tool directives.
  split    Flat files: tools/<name>.mod and tools/<name>.sum per tool.
  module   Dedicated subdirectories: tools/<name>/go.mod per tool.

Examples:
  gotools init --strategy=module --dir=tools

Exit Codes:
  0  Success            Everything worked
  1  Generic failure    Something went wrong (catch-all)
  2  Usage error        Bad flags, wrong args, invalid input
  3  Network error      Proxy unreachable, DNS failure, timeout
  4  Lock contention    Another gotools process holds the lock
  5  Tool not found     Requested tool isn't installed
  6  Offline required   Network needed but `--offline` set
  7  Policy violation   Tool banned, version not pinned, vuln found
  8  Environment error  Go missing/too old, bad manifest schema
